scope: Pointwise language holdouts selected before testing the final-no pattern layer; not a full-word oracle.
rationale: DPD 2.1 requires syllable boundaries and explicitly illustrates teléfo-no. Cervantes Plan Curricular B1-B2 §3.1.1 assigns a single intervocalic consonant to the following syllable. In the Spanish intervocalic sequence Vno, the single n begins the following syllable. Check the same boundary in independent final-no words; never split the adjacent vowel sequence or n from its vowel. Edge minima still apply.
